/kun nas 'bar ba'i me dpung gis/ /bskor ba'i gnas la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rnam par rgyas pa pad+ma yi/ /snying por nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor la/ / bsgyings pa'i tshul gyis legs bzhugs pa/ /rdo rje rnam 'joms dpal la 'dud/ / sna tshogs phrin las bsgrub pa'i phyir/ /sku mdog margad ltar gsal ba/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par spras/ /sprul pa'i 'od zer 'phro la 'dud/ /zhal gcig phyag gnyis spyan gsum pa/ /zhi dang khro dang 'dzum pa dang*/ /dpa' dang brtse ba'i nyams dang ldan/ /dbang phyug dam pa khyod la 'dud/ /sna tshogs rdo rje phyag g.yas kyis | | nyid kyi thugs kar bsgyings nas bsnams/ /g.yon pas dril bu dkur 'dzin pa/ /rnam rol khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsung gi rig sngags nga ro'i dbyangs | | 'brug sgra stong bzhin rnam sgrogs pas/ /bdud dpung ma lus zil gnon cing*/ /'dod rgu sbyin par mdzad la 'dud/ khyod thugs zab pas nyer zhi yang | | rgya che rol pas kun khyab mdzad/ /mi g.yo kun 'gro rtag brtan pa/ /ye shes dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal/ /yon tan phrin las rin chen gyi/ /mi bzad gter gyur mgon khyod la/ /rtag tu gus pas gsol 'debs kyi/ /dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol/ /zhes bstod cing gsol ba gdab par bya'o/ /gtor ma gnyis pa phyogs skyong rnams la dbul bar bya ste/ ja ma bzhin byin gyis brlabs nas | oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes brjod cing*/ snying ga nas 'phros pa'i 'od kyis phyogs skyong bcu 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la | pad+ma ka ma la ya s+t+waṃ gyis gdan phul la/ sa ma ya s+t+waṃ zhes pas dam tshig la gnas par byas te/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ an+d+rī ya/ ag+na ye/ ya mā ya | nai t+yā ya/ ba ru nā ya/ wā ya we/ ku be rā ya/ ī sha nā ya/ ur+dhaṃ brah+ma ṇā ya/ sūr+ya gra ha a dhi pa ta ye/ tsan+d+ra nak+ṣa tra a dhi pa ta ye/ a dh+wa pṛ thī bh+yaḥ

a su re bh+yaḥ nā ge bh+yaḥ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo/ bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā/ zhes brjod cing se gol brdab pa gsum mam bdun la sogs pas phul la mchod pa lngas mchod nas 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab bo/ /gsum pa 'byung po rnams la dbul bar bya ste/ snga ma ltar byin gyis brlabs nas/ oṃ sarba bhū ta e h+ye hi/ zhes brjod cing snying ga nas 'phros pa'i 'od kyis 'byung po thams cad bkug pa la/ gdan phul nas dam tshig la gnas par byas te/ nam mkha' mdzod kyi phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ de wa/ nā ga yak+ṣa/ gan+dha rba | a su ra/ ga ru ḍa/ kin+na ra/ ma ho ra ga ma nu ṣ+ya(《 zha 》 ṣa )/ a ma nu ṣ+ya (《 zha 》 ṣa )/ na ma s+sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ/ ud+ga te/ s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ gṛh+ṇe daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā/ zhes brjod cing*/ se gol brdab pa gsum mam bdun gyis phul nas/ mchod pa lngas mchod de/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab bo/ /gtor ma 'og ma gnyis rgyas par gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /de nas/ oṃ badz+ra muḥs ye shes pa dang*/ oṃ da sha dika lo ka pā la sa pa ri wā ra gats+tshas phyogs skyong rnams dang*/ oṃ sarba bh+rū ta gats+tshas 'byung po'i tshogs gshegs su gsol la gtor ma rnams gtong ngo*/ /gtor ma'o/ /bzhi pa sbyin sreg ni/ gsang sngags ma bzlas mi 'grub cing*/ /sbyin sreg ma byas 'bras mi 'byin/ /bzlas brjod 'bum phrag gcig la ni/ /sbyin sreg khri phrag bya bar bshad/ /ces 'byung bas sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba dang*/ mchog dang thun mong gi dngos grub bsgrub pa'i phyir/ bsnyen pa ji tsam song ba'i bcu cha sbyin sreg bya ste/ cho ga ni gzhan dang mtshungs pa nyid do/ /de lta na'ang khyad par cung zad yod pa ni 'chad pa po'i ngag las shes par bya'o/ /las so so dang 'brel pa'i sbyin sreg la/ nang gses kyis phye ba'i las tshogs mang du yod kyang rtsa ba'i las bzhir 'du bas (《

zha 》+ de brjod na )thab khung zhi ba la zlum po dkar po/ rgyas pa la gru bzhi ser po/ dbang la zla gam dmar po/ drag po la gru gsum nag po/ khru gang la sogs pa ji tsam yod pa'i rgya'i phyed zabs su bru zhing*/ sor bzhi pa la sogs pa'i kha khyer bskyed nas/ de nyid kyi tshad kyi mu ran brtsigs pa la zhi ba la rdo rje/ rgyas pa la rin po che/ dbang la pad+ma/ drag po la rdo rje gdengs pa'i mtshan ma dgod cing*/ dbus su pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte ba la sna tshogs rdo rje bri bar bya'o/ /bud shing ni zhi ba la 'o ma can/ rgyas pa la 'bras bu can/ dbang la me tog dmar po can/ drag po la tsher ma can/ ji ltar rigs pa brtsigs la/ rgyu de dag las byas pa'i yam shing dang | chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ gtor ma gnyis bcas la/ zhi ba la til/ tshe rgyas pa la dūr ba'i myu gu/ longs spyod rgyas pa la zho las byas pa'i zas mchog khyim gyi 'byor pa rgyas pa la 'bru sna tshogs/ shes rab rgyas pa la dri bzang po dang*/ sbrang rtsi sbyar ba'i ri lu/ drag po la yungs dkar dang*/ dug sna tshogs dang*/ thun mong du mar gyi bsreg rdzas rnams bsags la/ 'jam po gsum la bsreg rdzas g.yas/ mchod rdzas g.yon du bshams shing drag po la de las bzlog par bsham mo/ /de nas zhi ba la shar/ rgyas pa la byang*/ dbang la nub | drag po la lhor phyogs nas bdag gi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas bzlas pa ci rigs pa byas la/ las dang rjes su mthun pa'i me'am kha na ma tho ba med pa'i me sbar nas/ hūm̐ las rgya dang tshad ma nyams pa'i thab bud shing gi rtsig pa dwangs shing thogs pa med pa dang ldan par bskyed la/ hūm̐ gi sngags kyi byin gyis brlab bo | | de nas thab kyi dbus su pad+ma'i gdan la ram̐ las byung ba'i me lha las dang rjes su mthun pa'i mdog can ra skyes la zhon pa/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ g.yas pa gnyis kyis mchog sbyin dang bgrang phreng*/

g.yon pa gnyis kyis dbyu gu (《 zha 》+ rtse )gsum pa dang ril ba spyi blugs 'dzin pa/ drang srong gi cha lugs 'dzin pa | bskyed pa'i gnas gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gi byin gyis brlabs la/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra e h+ye hi/ zhes brjod cing*/ snying ga nas 'phros pa'i 'od kyis shar lho nas me lha 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs dam tshig pa la bstim nas/ oṃ ag+na ye zhes sngon du 'gro ba'i ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod nas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mchog gi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal pos mchog tu dbang bskur zhing*/ /shes rab me yi nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'dzin byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod la/ yam shing dang*/ mar dang*/ las dang rjes su 'brel ba'i bsreg rdzas rnams/ oṃ ag+na ye swā hā/ zhes pas phul nas/ shin tu mnyes par gyur par bsams nas/ slar yang mchod cing bstod la/ oṃ ag+na ye dz+wa la ram̐/ zhes brjod pas me lha 'bar ba'i dbus su rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa bdag bskyed bzhin rdzogs par bskyed pa'i mthar/ rtsa ba dang brgyud par bcas pa'i bla ma rnams dang*/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba dmigs la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra bi dā ra ṇa/ sa pa ri wā ra zhes sngon du 'gro bas ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha (《 zha 》+ ye )swā hā/ la sogs pa rnams kyis mchod la ci shes pa rnams kyis bstod nas/ sngar smos pa'i bsreg rdzas thams cad yang snying 'ba' zhig gis dbul lo/ /de'ang zhi ba la sdig pa thams cad shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ de bzhin du rgyas pa la tshe dang bsod nams puṣ+tiṃ ku ru oṃ dang*/ dbang du bya ba la che ge mo wa shaṃ ku ru hoḥdang*/ drag po la che ge mo mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces spel tshig rnams brjod par bya'o/ /'jig rten pa'i me lha'ang tshul 'di bzhin du sbyar bar bya'o/ /de nas 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i me lha la slar yang mchod cing bstod nas 'dod pa'i don gsol ba btab la/

yi ge brgya pas lhag chad kha bskangs nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba bsngos la/ oṃ khyed kyis sems can don kun mdzad/ /rjes su mthun pa'i dngos grub stsol/ /sangs rgyas yul du gshegs nas kyang*/ /slar yang 'byon par mdzad du gsol/ /oṃ badz+ra muḥ zhes pas ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu/ slar yang 'bar ba me lha'i rnam par gyur pa la snga ma bzhin mchod cing bstod nas/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba btab la nongs par spyad pa bzod par gsol nas/ oṃ ag+na ye sa pa ri wā ra gats+tsha/ zhes brjod nas/ ye shes pa rang gi gnas su gshegs su gsol la/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdus nas/ rang gi gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis bsrungs la/ thal ba mi 'gom pa'i sar rol mo dang bcas pas rgya mtshor 'bab pa'i chu bor dor te/ las kyi rjes mi mngon par byas la dga' ston la longs spyad par bya'o/ /sbyin sreg gi cho ga'o/ /gzhung gi 'bru gnyer bar 'dod na/ gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /brgyud pa'i rim pa ni/ rdzogs sangs rgyas dang phyag na rdo rje dpal/ /dze tā ri dang rdo rje gdan pa dang*/ /rdo rje gdan pa gnyis par grags pa dang*/ /rje btsun ba ri chos rje sa skya pa/ /dpal ldan rtse mo'i zhabs dang rgyal mtshan zhabs/ /chos kyi bzang po'i zhabs kyi zhal snga nas/ /bdag gis gus pa'i yid kyis nos pa'o/ /de ltar brgyud pa'i rim pa las 'ongs pa'i/ /sgrub thabs rim pa rab tu gsal ba 'di/ /rgyal mtshan dpal la sogs pas gsol btab nas/ /sngags 'chang 'phags pa zhes byas sbyar ba yin/ /de las byung ba'i dge ba rdo rje yis/ /bdud kyi dkyil 'khor ma lus rab bcom nas/ /bdag dang gzhan gyis rdo rje rnam 'joms pa'i/ /go 'phang dam pa nye bar thob par shog / bcom ldan 'das rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa'i sgrub thabs kyi ris(《 zha 》 rim )pa rje btsun chen po'i zhal snga nas mdzad du zin yang*/ shin tu gsal bar phye ba la mos pa rnams kyi don du chu pho khyi'i lo smal po'i zla ba'i yar gyi ngo la rgyal po chen po'i pho brang du sbyar ba'o//

//༄༅/ /'jam dpal gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'phags pa 'jam dpal bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du 'jam dpal bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas rang gi snying gi nang du pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du dhīḥdamar ser gcig bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas rang gi sdig pa dang mi shes pa thams cad dag ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas 'od 'phros pas sems can thams cad la phog pas sems can ∶gyi (《 zha 》 thams cad kyis )sdig pa dang ma rig pa (《 zha 》+ thams cad ) bsal | 'od tshur 'dus nas rang la thim pas/ rang gi lus 'jam dpal du gyur par bsam/ de'ang pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ zhal gcig pa phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa na shes rab kyi ral gri ∶nam mkha' la 'phyar ba(《 zha 》 'dzin pa ) / g.yon pa na me tog ut+pa la'i steng na shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa'i pu sti 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can/ sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ gzhon nu lo bcu drug lon pa lta bu'i cha byad can mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsgom/ de'i dpral ba oṃ dkar po zhu ba las 'jam dpal dkar po/ mgrin par āḥlas 'jam dpal dmar po/ snying gar hūm̐ las 'jam dpal sngon po/ phyag mtshan dang rnam pa rang 'dra bar bsgom/ snying ga'i 'jam dpal gyi thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du yi ge dhīḥdamar ser zhig bsgom/ de las 'od 'phros pas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes rang nyid la zhugs par bsams la dhīḥ'i mtha' mar sngags kyis bskor bar dmigs shing*/ oṃ a ra pa tsa na dhā+-iḥ zhes pa ci nus pa bzla/ de'i rjes su/ na mo mañdzu shrī ku mā ra bhū tā ya/

bo dhi sa twā ya/ ma hā sa twā ya/ ma hā ka ru ṇi kā ya/ tad+ya thā/ oṃ a ra dze bi ra dze/ shud+dhe bi shud+dhe/ sho dha ne bi sho dha ne/ sho dha ya bi sho dha ya/∶bi ma le/( sde mchan / gzungs rnams/ a ma le/ bi ma le/ nirma le/ zhes 'byung yang phyi mo rnams na mi 'dug pas dpyad/ ) dza ya wa re/ ru ru tsa le hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ gzungs kyang ci rigs pa bzla/ mthar dge ba'i rtsa ba sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas su bsngo/ 'jam dpal gyi sgom thabs me pho 'brug gi lo ston zla ra ba la rgyal bu mu gas bskul nas 'phags pas bshad cing bris nas phul lo// //༄༅/ /'jam dpal dpa' bo grub pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /'jam pa'i dpa' bo grub pa'i sgrub thabs zhes bya ba/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi ye shes kun nas rab gsal ba/ /sna tshogs gdul bya'i yid la mnyam par 'jug /rmongs pa'i thibs po kun nas sel mdzad pa | | 'jam pa'i rdo rje'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'jam pa'i rdo rje yis | | dpa' bo grub par gang gsungs pa'i/ /gtso bo'i sgrub thabs rim pa 'di | | bdag gis rim par bshad par bya/ /de la dpa' bo grub pa bsgom par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ khrus dang gtsang sbra la sogs pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dben pa'i gnas su skyil mo krung gis 'dug la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du byang chub bsgrub pa'i 'dun pa dang ldan pas/ snying gi dbus su pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du muṃ gyi yi ge las rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer byung bas/ rang gi rgyud kyi sgrib pa sbyangs nas slar yang ba spu'i bu ga thams cad nas spros pas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa'i sems can ∶thams cad kyi (《 zha 》 gyi )sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs nas/ de nyid kyi snang bas | mgon po dpa' bo grub pa la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor ba spyan drangs la phyag 'tshal ba dang*/

mchod pa sngon du 'gro bas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ /zhes bya ba yan lag bdun pa lan gsum byas la/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms nas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas phyi nang gi chos thams cad stong par bsgom mo/ / stong pa'i dang las pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su mum̐ gyi mtha' mar/ oṃ badz+ra tik+ṣ+ṇa/ duḥkha/ ts+tshe da/ pra dzñā/ dzñā na murta ye/ dzñā na/ kā ya wā gī shwa ra a ra pa tsa na ya te na maḥ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od zer gyi snang ba phyogs bcur spros pas sems can gyi khams ma lus pa'i sdig pa thams cad rnam par sbyangs nas/ bde ba'i mchog la bkod de/ slar 'dus nas yi ge de nyid la thim pas/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das dpa' bo grub pa/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng na bzhugs pa/ ston ka'i zla ba ltar (《 zha 》+ rab tu*/ )dkar ba/ zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas pas mchog sbyin dang*/ g.yon pas ut+pal thugs kar 'dzin cing snyan gyi thad sor rgyas pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis rab tu brgyan zhing*/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bzas klubs pa/ rab tu zhi zhing dar la bab pa | 'od zer du ma 'phro ba dang sdud pa'i bdag nyid can du bsams la/ dpral ba dang | mgrin pa dang*/ snying gar/ oṃ dang*/ āḥdang*/ hūm̐ gi yi ge dkar po dang*/ dmar po dang*/ sngon po rnams rim pa bzhin du bsams la/ bdag bskyed de nyid byin gyis brlabs pa'i phyir lha'i sku la dmigs la/ oṃ ād+ya nut+pan+na pra kṛ ti/ pra bha wa | swa ra su bi shud+dha/ dharma dhā tu badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /de nas de'i snying ga'i sa bon gyi yi ge las 'od zer lcags kyu'i rnam pa can dpag tu med pa spros pas/ 'jam pa'i rdo rje la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' nam mkha'i gtos khyab pas yongs su bskor ba spyan drangs la/ mchod pa lngas mngon par mchod de/

oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes bya ba'i sngags kyi rang dang gnyis su med par bstim par byas la/ yang*/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya wāka tsit+ta badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod la brtan par bya'o/ /yang dbang bskur ba'i slad du/ de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga rig ma dang sems dpa' dang*/ khro bo'i tshogs kyis yongs su bskor ba spyan drangs la/ yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod pas mchod nas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes gsol ba btab pas khro bo rnams kyis bgegs bskrad/ rig ma dang byang chub sems dpas bkra shis brjod/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing*/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsis yongs su gang ba'i bum pa'i chus tshangs pa'i bu ga nas dbang bskur bas phyi dang nang gi dri ma thams cad dag par sbyangs/ rang gi lus ye shes kyi chus yongs su gang*/ rigs kyi bdag po/ dbang bskur gyi lha rnams gcig tu gyur te/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi rnam pa can gyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /lha'i sku de nyid kyang snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur dmigs la/ rnal 'byor pa'i blo mnyam par bzhag par bya'o/ /de nas mnyam par bzhag pa las langs te/ bzlas pa byed par 'dod pas rang gi snying gi nang du pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du mum̐ gyi mtha' mar bskyed pa'i sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba la dmigs pa gtad de bzlas par bya'o/ /bsnyen pa'i grangs ni 'bum phrag bcu gsum mo/ /oṃ he he ∶tiṣ+ṭha(《 zha 》 tiṣ+ṭha ) / ban+dha ban+dha dha ra ya dha ra ya ni run+dha ni run+dha ur+ṇa ma ṇi ye swā hā/ zhes bya ba 'di mdzod spu nor bu zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags te/ lha'i rnal 'byor 'di nyid la gnas nas/ las thams cad rgyud las 'byung ba ltar bsgrub par bya ste/ thams cad du thogs pa med par shes par bya'o/

/gsung rab rgya mtsho'i gling las legs 'ongs shing*/ /yang dag bla ma klu dbang gis bsten pa'i/ /man ngag rin chen phreng ba kho bos spel/ /ye shes lha yi rgyan gyis mdzes par shog /dpa' bo gcig tu grub pa'i sgrub thabs/ bla ma dam pa'i zhal las 'byung ba bzhin/ dge tshul blo gros rgyal mtshan dpal bzang pos shing pho stag gi lo bya spo'i zla ba la mdo khams sgang du sbyar ba'o// //༄༅/ /thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len tshul bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo/ / stan bde ba la skyil mo krung gis bsdad la/ bla ma la skyabs su mchi/ sangs rgyas la skyabs su mchi/ chos la skyabs su mchi/ dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi/ zhes skyabs su 'gro ba lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du ting nge 'dzin zab mo bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom | de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā' s+sā bhā wa shud+dho?&haṃ/ zhes brjod pas rang gi lus mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du sangs kyis bsgom/ de nas rang nyid skad cig gis rin po che'i khri pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ thugs rje chen po sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa phyag dang po gnyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar nas/ sangs rgyas thams cad la sems can gyi don mdzad par bskul ba/ g.yas kyi 'og mas phreng ba dkar po dang*/ g.yon gyi 'og mas rin po che dang bcas pa'i pad+ma 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i dbu rgyan/ rna rgyan/ mgul rgyan/ la sogs pa'i rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' mnabs pa/ sku las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phro bas sems can gyi don mdzad pa/ spyi bo na sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes gcig tu bsdus pa'i ngo bo 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan pa snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bu bsgoms la yid cung zad gzung*/

de nas spyi bo'i 'od dpag tu med pa la dmigs nas/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas tshe dpag tu med pas bdag gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyang zhing bsod nams dang ye shes kyi tshogs myur du rgyas pa dang*/ yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin dam pa rgyud la skyes nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes snying thag pa nas lan gsum gsol ba gdab/ de nas bde ba dang sdug bsngal dang 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa'i rtsa ba thams cad rang gi sems yin la/ sems de'ang brtags na kha dog dang dbyibs su ma grub/ gcig dang du ma yang ma yin pas rang gi ngo bos stong*/ ngo bo med pa'i dbang gis gdod ma nas skye ba med pas dang po rgyus stong

| skye ba med pa'i phyir sdod pa med pas/ bar du gnas pas stong*/ gnas rgyu med pa'i phyir 'jig pa med pas tha ma 'gags pas stong pas gzhi dang rtsa ba med cing spros pa thams cad dang bral ba nam mkha' lta bu'o zhes spros pa bcad la/ mtshan ma dang rnam par rtog pa gang yang mi bsgom zhing yid la mi byed par spros bral gyi ngang la yid lhod de mnyam par bzhag phyi nas goms pa dang*/ sems mi 'phro zhing*/ nang du gnas pa yun ring du 'byung*/ de nas rang gi snying gar hrīḥ bsgoms pa las sngags kyi phreng ba 'od kyi tshul du 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje bskul nas bdag la byin gyis rlob cing sems can gyi don mdzad par bsgoms nas/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes ci nus pa bzla/ bzlas pa tshar ba dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba des sangs rgyas thob par gyur cig ces bsngo'o/ /spyod lam gyi tshe rang 'dug pa'i gnas bde ba can yin la/ rang nyid bcom ldan 'das mgon po tshe dpag tu med pa'i zhabs drung na jo bo thugs rje chen po'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas gnas pa yin snyam pa'i bsam pa dang mi 'bral bar bya'o/ /de ltar rtag tu rnal 'byor du byas na tshe 'dir tshe ring zhing bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang | skye ba phyi mar bde ba can gyi zhing khams su skyes nas myur du mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /jo bo thugs rje chen po dang phyag rgya chen po zung 'jug tu nyams su len pa'i tshul/ rje sa skya pa'i man ngag zab mo 'di rang gi slob ma mo ston tsa ge ju 'phur zhes bya bas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ 'phags pas me pho byi ba'i lo zla ba bzhi pa'i tshes brgyad la skya rka mdor yi ger bkod pa'o || || ༄༅/ /thugs rje chen po phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dang 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la phyag 'tshal lo | | bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po bsgom par 'dod pas/

stan bde ba la bsdad | bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du thugs rje chen po bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas rang gi snying gi nang du/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hrīḥdakar po las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ spyi gtsug nas rkang pa'i mthil gyi bar gyi lus thams cad yongs su gang*/ sdig pa dang | sgrib pa dang*/ nad dang*/ sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs/ phar 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus nas rang la thim pas/ rang nyid thugs rje chen por gyur pa ni/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la | rdo rje skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa | phyag dang po gnyis sangs rgyas thams cad la thal mo sbyar nas/ sems can gyi don la bskul ba/ g.yas kyi gnyis pas phreng ba dkar po dang*/ g.yon gyi gnyis pas rin po che dang bcas pa'i pad+ma dkar po 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bzas klubs pa/ rab tu zhi zhing gzi brjid mtha' yas pa/ spyi bor 'od dpag tu med pa'i dbu rgyan can/ snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur bsgoms pa la yid gtad de mnyam par bzhag go /de nas sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ snying gi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ yi ge hrīḥbasgoms pa'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba'i 'od kyis/ bdag gi sdig pa dang*/ sgrib pa dang*/ nad dang*/ sdug bsngal thams cad sbyangs/ phyir 'phros pas sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs | tshur 'dus pas sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rje rang la 'jug par bsam zhing*/ hūm̐ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bzla bar bya'o/ /phreng ba'i mdo 'dzin nas/ mdo 'dzin la ma slebs kyi bar du tshig gzhan gyis bar ma chod par bzla/

grangs kyi bsnyen pa'i tshad ni 'bum phrag drug cu ste/ des las kyi tshogs ji skad bshad pa rnams 'grub la/ byang chub bsgrub pa la ni tshad med do/ / de nas bzlas pa tshar ba dang*/ dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas su bsngos nas/ spyod lam thams cad lha'i nga rgyal gyis bya'o/ /rang dang gzhan gyi nad kyi zug rngu sel bar 'dod pas/ gang na ba'i sar/ zla ba la gnas pa'i hrīḥ'i yi ge las/ bdud rtsi'i rgyun bab pas/ zug rngu thams cad bsal zhing*/ bde bas gang ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang ldan pas/ yi ge drug pa'i sngags kyis mngon par bsngags par bya'o/ / sngags kyi chus bdag dang gzhan la phan gdags par 'dod na/ chu gtsang ma'i nang du/ pad+ma 'dab ma drug pa'i lte bar hrīḥ 'dab ma rnams la rim pa bzhin yi ge drug pa bkod nas/ de rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs pas/ snod yongs su gang bar bsam zhing*/ yi ge drug pas mngon par bsngags pa'i chu 'thungs pa dang | bkrus pas nad dang*/ zug rngu sel bar bya ba'o/ /nyal ba'i tshe stong pa nyid kyi ngang la nyal zhing*/ ldang ba'i tshe lha'i nga rgyal gyis ldang bar bya'o/ /'di'i rnal 'byor gyis rtag tu gnas na/ gnas skabs su nad dang sdug bsngal zhi zhing*/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs nas mthar byang chub 'grub pa nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das thugs rje chen po'i sgrub pa'i thabs/ chos rje sa skya pa'i gsung bzhin/ 'phags pas rgya'i yul du yi ger bkod pa'o// //༄༅/ /thugs rje chen po'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /thugs rje chen po bsgom par 'dod pas/ stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du thugs rje chen po bsgom snyam pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom | de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/

zhes brjod pas/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad mi dmigs pa stong pa nyid du bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las rang 'dug pa'i gnas 'di sangs rgyas kyi zhing dag pa bde ba can du bsam/ de'i dbus su ram̐ las rin po che'i khri dang*/ pam̐ las pad+ma ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du rang gi shes pa hrīḥdakar por bsam/ de las 'od zer phar 'phros pas/ sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus pa las rang gi lus thugs rje chen por gyur par bsam/ de yang sku mdog dkar po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ zhabs gnyis rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs pa/ phyag dang po gnyis kyis thugs kar thal mo sbyar nas/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la/ sems can gyi don mdzad par gsol ba 'debs pa/ g.yas kyi gnyis pa na phreng ba 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi gnyis pa na me tog pad+ma dkar po'i steng na rin po che bzhag pa 'dzin pa/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs pa'i na bza' can/ spyi bor 'od dpag med pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ de'i thugs kar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du (《 zha 》+ yi ge )hrīḥdakar po (《 zha 》+ gcig )bsam/ hrīḥ'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor bar dmigs nas/ de las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi byin rlabs rang la 'jug pa dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi nad dang sdig pa thams cad dag par bsam zhing*/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes pa'i sngags ci nus pa bzla/ mthar dge ba'i rtsa ba sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas su bsngo/ nub mo nyal ba'i tshe/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ngang la nyal/ ldang ba'i tshe skad cig gis jo bo thugs rje chen po'i nga rgyal gyis ldang*/ spyod lam thams cad thugs rje chen po'i nga rgyal gyis bya/ glo bur gyi nad byung na gang na ba'i sar hrīḥdakar po bsams pa las bdud rtsi dkar nar ba byung bas nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad bsal nas/

bde bas gang bar bsam zhing yid gzhag sems zin na nad las grol bar 'gyur ro/ /rang gzhan gyi don du sngags chu byed na/ rin po che'i snod gtsang ma chu gtsang gis bkang ba'i nang du/ pad+ma 'dab ma drug pa'i lte bar hrīḥmadun nas 'dab ma rnams la rim pa bzhin/ oṃ ma ṇi pad+me hūm̐/ zhes pa bkod pa bsgoms nas/ yi ge rnams las bdud rtsi'i rgyun 'dzag par bsam zhing*/ yi ge re re la dmigs shing*/ sngags brgya rtsa re re brjod la mchil ma gdab bo/ /de 'thung ba dang*/ bkrus pa dang*/ byugs pa la sogs pas/ rang gzhan gyi don bya'o | | las kyi tshogs gzhan ni gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /rtag tu bsgom par byas na/ tshe 'di la nad dang*/ sdug bsngal mi 'byung zhing*/ mthar thug 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /thugs rje chen po bsgom pa'i thabs sa pho stag gi lo la rdo rje khye'u 'dren gyis bskul ba'i don du 'phags pas bshad cing bris nas phul ba'o// //༄༅/ /seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la (《 zha 》+ gus par )phyag 'tshal lo/ /'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra bsgom par 'dod pas/ gnas dben par khrus dang gtsang sbra byas la stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba lan gsum bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya | de'i don du 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra bsgom snyam du ∶byang chub kyi sems bsgom(《 zha 》 sems bskyed )/ de nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmā' s+sa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ | zhes brjod pas/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las am̐ las rin po che'i khri'i steng du pam̐ las pad+ma dang a las zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du/ yi ge āḥ dkar po tsheg drag dang bcas pa yongs su gyur pa las seng ge dkar po kha gyen du phyogs shing*/ ral pa dmar po (《 zha 》+ thur du )'phyang ba'i steng du rang nyid seng ge sgra sku mdog dkar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa drang srong gi cha lugs can/

phyag g.yas pa brkyang zhing g.yon pa gdan la btsugs pas dku brten pa/ rgyan thams cad spangs zhing mchod phyir thogs 'chang ba/ ri dwags khri snyan sa le'i lpags pa'i stod g.yogs dang*/ dar dmar po'i smad g.yogs can | sku mdzes shing cung zad rid pa/ g.yon na pad+ma dkar po'i steng na ral gri 'bar ba snyan gyi thad sor slebs pa/ yal ga gyes pa'i steng na klu shing gi me tog gis gang ba'i thod pa dang*/ g.yas kyi phyogs su tri shū la la sbrul dkar po (《 zha 》+ g.yas phyogs su )'khril ba yod par bsgom/ de'i dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ snying gar hūm̐/ snying gi nang du hrīḥbasam/ de las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas/ 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra spyan drangs la/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥs rang la gnyis su med par bstim/ yang 'od 'phros pas sangs rgyas rigs lnga spyan drangs | oṃ ar+ghaṃ/ pā d+yaṃ/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐/(《 zha 》+ oṃ badz+ra shab+da a hūm̐/ )zhes pas mchod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/(《 zha 》+ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi/ )oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur bas dri ma thams cad dgachu lhag ma yar lud pas 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan par bsam/ de'i tshe rigs lnga'i 'phro ba 'grub ste/ spyi gtsug tu 'od dpag med/ phrag pa g.yas pa'i steng du rnam par snang mdzad/ phrag pa g.yas pa'i 'og tu rin chen 'byung ldan/ phrag pa g.yon pa'i steng du mi bskyod pa/ phrag pa g.yon pa'i 'og tu don yod grub pa bkod par bsam/ de nas snying gi nang gi hrīḥ'i mtha' ma sngags kyi phreng bas 'khor ba'i 'od kyis/ rang gi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang nad dang sdug bsngal sbyangs par bsam zhing*/ oṃ āḥhrīḥsiṃ ha nā da hūm̐ phaṭa/

ci nus pa bzla/ bzlas pa tshar ba dang | oṃ badz+ra muḥs rang la bstim pa'i ye shes pa gshegs su gsol/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ /de nas gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas/ dkar gtor bshams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlab/ mdun du 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra spyan drangs pa la phul bar bsam zhing*/ sngags snga ma bzhin lan gsum mam bdun brjod pas phul la/ ar+ghaṃ la sogs pas mchod nas/ thams cad mkhyen pa'i spyan ras kyis/ /sems can kun la rab gzigs shing*/ /stobs dang mi 'jigs mnga' ba po/ /seng ge sgra la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod nas/ bdag gi nad dang gdon dang bar du gcod pa thams cad zhi ba dang*/ bsam pa thams cad chos bzhin du 'grub par ∶mdzad du (《 zha 》 byin gyis brlab tu )gsol/ zhes 'dod pa'i don gsol ba btab/ de nas gtor ma'i mgron gshegs su gsol/ 'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs mdor bsdus pa rje sa skya pa'i man ngag 'di/ las dang po pa rnams kyi don du 'phags pas me pho byi ba'i lo zla ba gsum pa'i nyi shu gsum la sgang rar sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o// //(《 zha 》+ maṅga laṃ/ oṃ gyis 'byung po thams cad bsdu/ / āḥyis rdzas rnams dag sogs bya/ /hūm̐ gis 'brel pa khyab par sbyin/ /de ni sku gsung sbyor ba yin/ /'jig rten dbang phyug seng ge sgra'i sgrub thabs bsdus pa rdzogs so// )༄༅/ /rta mgrin ∶khyung gshog can (《 zha 》+ khyung gshog can )gyi sgrub thabs bzhugs// ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ khro bo'i rgyal po rta mgrin khyung gshog can bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang sems bskyed pa sngon du song nas/ rgyas pa la spro na/ tshogs kyi zhing spyan drang ba dang*/ yan lag bdun pa dang*/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom/ bsdus pa la spro na/ sems bskyed pa'i rjes thogs nyid la/

shū n+ya tā'i sngags kyis stong par bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du/ rang gi sems hrīḥlas pad+ma hrīḥs mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus nas yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid bcom ldan 'das rta mchog sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa/ rtsa ba'i zhal dmar/ g.yas dkar/ g.yon sngo ba'i dbu gsum gyi steng na rgya cher bzhad cing 'tshor ba'i rta mgo ljang zhur(《 zha 》 khu )/ rngog ma dmar po dang ldan pa gsum yod pa/ zhal re re la dmar zhing 'khrug pa'i spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje dang*/ be con dang*/ zhags pa/ g.yon gsum na khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang*/ ral gri dang*/ rab tu gdengs pa'i phyag gi sor mo lnga las rigs lnga'i bya khyung 'phro ba/ rdo rje'i gshog pa kun tu gdengs pas phyogs kyi khongs rgyas par khyab pa/ zhabs g.yas cung zad bskum pas pho rgyud kyi gdon dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad dang*/ g.yon brkyang pas mo rgyud kyi tshogs mnan pa/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ rin po che dang sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ rtsa zhal gyi mtshog ma'i steng du 'od dpag tu med pas dbur brgyan zhing*/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par dmigs pa'i gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi sems rtse gcig tu mnyam par bzhag go /sngags zlo bar 'dod pas snying gi nang nyi ma'i steng du hrīḥbasam pa'i mtha' ma sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba la dmigs nas/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci nus bzlas so/ /de nas shas brgyan pa'i gtor ma/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum gyis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por byin gyis brlabs te/ mdun du spyan drangs pa'i bcom ldan 'das dpal rta mchog la dbul bar bsam zhing*/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ha ya gṛ wa hu lu hu lu i daṃ ba liṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi hūm̐ phaṭa/

ces pa'i sngags kyis dbul zhing mchod la/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba btab ste/ gshegs su gsol lo/ /rta mgrin khyung gshog can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs/ bla ma'i gsung bzhin shing phag khra zla'i tshes nyi shu'i nyin par 'phags pas tre'i sa char bkod pa'o

|| || ༄༅/ /byams pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /rje btsun bla ma dam pa dang*/ 'phags pa byams pa la phyag 'tshal lo | | 'phags pa byams pa bsgom par 'dod pa'i rten gyi gang zag gis byang chub tu sems bskyed nas thog mar gdong la sogs pa dag par byas te/ stan bde ba la 'dug nas/ dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba (《 zha 》+ lan gsum )bya ste/ sems can thams cad kyi don du rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du mgon po byams pa bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgom/ de nas snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ maiṃ dmar ser gcig bsam/ de las 'od byung bas sems can thams cad kyi rgyud la phog rgyud kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ tshur 'dus pa las rang gi lus kyi dri ma dang*/ tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa dang bar du gcod pa thams cad dag ste/ lus shel sgong dag pa ltar sangs kyis dag par bsam/ de nas skad cig la (《 zha 》+ 'phags pa )mgon po byams pa sku mdog dmar ser zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ phyag g.yas pa mchog sbyin pa/ g.yon chos 'chad pa'i phyag rgya mtheb mdzub sbyar ba'i bar na klu shing gi me tog 'dzin pa/ de'i steng na ril ba spyi blugs bzhag pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs kyi gseb na byang chub chen po'i mchod rten yod pa/ rin po che'i rgyan gyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi stod g.yogs dang*/ smad g.yogs can/ pad+ma dang zla ba'i gdan la skyil mo krung ngam/ skyil mo krung phyed pas bzhugs par bsam par bya'o | | de nas rang gi snying ga'i maiṃ las 'od 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs thams cad spyan drangs la bdag la bstim mo/ /dpral bar oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ nag po'i byin gyis brlabs/ spyi bor mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsams la/ snying gar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du maiṃ gyi mtha' ma na phar la sngags kyis bskor bar bsams la/

ji srid du blo gnas kyi bar du bsgom/ gal te rnam par rtog pa 'phro na gsang sngags bzla bar bya ste/ snying ga'i yi ge la ∶zlog pa (《 zha 》 klog dar )lta bur dmigs la/ oṃ āḥmaiṃ mai tri ye hūm̐ swā hā/ zhes bzla bar bya'o/ /'gro 'chag nyal 'dug spyod lam rnam pa bzhi ka 'phags pa byams pa'i nga rgyal dang ldan par bya'o/ /bsgom bzlas kyi rnal 'byor ro/ /gal te thun mtshams su gtor ma gtong bar 'dod na/ ci 'byor pa'i gtor ma yi ge gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs la/ mdun du 'phags pa byams pa dam tshig pa bskyed/ de la ye shes pa spyan drangs la/ de'i ljags rdo rje'i sbu gu'i gtor ma gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rang gi sngags lan gsum gyis dbul/ mnyes shing tshim par bsams la mchod pa lngas mchod/ bstod pas bstod/ ji ltar 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab/ spyan drangs pa gshegs su gsol/ dam tshig pa bdag la bstim/ gtor ma sa gtsang sar gtang ngo*/ /thun mtshams su bsgrub pa'i maṇ+ḍal byed par 'dod na/ maṇ+ḍal khru gang pa la me tog gi tshom bu dgu la dbus su mgon po byams pa la de bzhin gshegs pa rigs bzhi dang yum bzhis bskor bar bsams la/ de la mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma phul la 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba btab ste/ dngos grub blangs la tshar ba dang mi dmigs par bsam mo/ /gzungs chog byed par 'dod na/ bum pa bca' ba la sogs gzhung gzhan dang mthun par byas la/ bum pa'i nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gsang sngags dgod/ bum pa'i steng du 'phags pa byams pa bsgom/ de'i phyag las bdud rtsi'i chu byung bas bum pa'i yi ge la thim pas yi ge 'od du zhu bas bum pa'i nang khengs par bsam zhing gsang sngags bzla/ bzlas pa tshar ba dang*/ 'phags pa byams pa la mchod pa dang gtor mas mchod la gshegs su gsol/ chu des rang dang gzhan la phan gdags par byas na/ phan yon bsam gyis mi khyab gsung*/ de nyid la sngags 'dag byed na'ang khrus chus sa dkar po dri ma med pa sprus pa ri lu bya/

de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gsang sngags bkod pa de las bdud rtsi'i chu rgyun byung bas ri lu la thim pas bdud rtsis mer gyis gyur par bsgoms la/ de lta bu'i ril bus bdag gzhan la phan gdags par bya'o/ /srung skud byed na skud pa gtsang ma la rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum mam lnga byas la/ snyim pa'i bar du bcug la/ de'i steng du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du gsang sngags bkod la 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i skud par bsgoms la/ de la rten 'brel gyi sngags gsum mam lnga bzlas pas rab gnas byas la phan gdags par bya'o/ /'di nyams su blangs pa'i phan yon dpag tu med pa ni gzhung gzhan ltar shes par bya'o/ /'phags pa byams pa'i chos skor yan lag dang bcas pa rdzogs so/ /bla ma ba ri lo tsā ba'i gdams ngag sa skya pa'i zhal gdams yi ger (《 zha 》+ 'phags pas )bkod pa'o/ /∶sa māp+ta mi thi//(《 zha 》 - sa māp+ta mi thi// ) ༄༅/ /mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dang rje btsun mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rje btsun mi g.yo ba bsgom par 'dod pa'i gang zag gis/ stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du rje btsun mi g.yo ba bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bsgom/ de nas rang gi snying gi nang du nyi ma'i steng du*/ hūm̐ sngon po bsgoms pa las 'od zer dpag tu med pa 'phros pas spyi gtsug nas rkang pa'i mthil gyi bar du lus yongs su gang*/ sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad sbyangs*/ phyir 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas/ slar rang la 'dus pas/ rang nyid rje btsun khro bo'i rgyal por gyur pa ni/ pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi gdan la/ pus mo g.yon pa'i lha nga (《 zha 》+ sa )gzhi la btsugs shing*/ g.yas pa bzhengs stabs kyi tshul gyis bzhugs pa/

zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa/ sku mdog sngon po/ phyag g.yas pas ye shes kyi ral gri nam mkha' la 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pa la rdo rje'i zhags pas dkris pa/ spyan gsum gyi g.yas pa steng du gzigs pas lha'i bdud tshar gcod cing*/ g.yon pa 'og tu gzigs pas klu'i bdud tshar gcod pa/ dbus ma thad kar gzigs pas bgegs phra mo thams cad 'joms shing*/ ya sos ma mchu mnan pa/ klu dang sa bdag dbang du 'dus pa'i rtags su sbrul dkar po se ral khar byas ∶shing*/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan zhing (《 zha 》 pa/ )/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can/ ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings pa'i steng du/ sangs rgyas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i thugs kar ye shes sems dpa' ∶de nyid (《 zha 》 rang )dang 'dra ba/ de'i yang thugs kar ting nge 'dzin sems dpa' hūm̐ nas 'bru tsam zhig dmigs nas/ de thams cad kyang snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi gzugs brnyan lta bur dmigs pa la yid gtad la mnyam par bzhag go /de nas sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ ting nge 'dzin sems dpa'i mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng ba 'khor ba'i 'od kyis bdag gi sdig sgrib dang*/ gdon thams cad sbyangs shing*/ phyir 'phros pas/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa sbyangs nas/ khro rgyal gyi go 'phang la bkod/ sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ye shes bskul bas bdag la byin gyis rlob par bsam zhing*/ oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ji srid mi skyo'i bar du bzla'o/ /phreng ba'i mdo 'dzin nas bzung nas mdo 'dzin la ma slebs kyi bar du ngag gzhan gyis bar ma chod par bya'o/ /grangs kyi bsnyen pa'i tshad ni 'bum phrag brgyad cu'o/ /byang chub bsgrub pa la ni tshad med do/ /bzlas pa tshar ba dang | dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas su bsngos la/ spyod lam thams cad lha'i nga rgyal gyis bya'o/

/gtor ma gtong ba'i tshe/ dkar gtor drug cu rtsa bzhi la sogs pa bshams la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ tas ma dag pa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā was stong par bsam | stong pa'i ngang las/ oṃ zhes brjod pas/ rin po che'i snod rgya chen po dang | āḥzhes brjod pas/ de lha'i bdud rtsis gang ba dang*/ hūm̐ zhes brjod pas/ ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rang bzhin du gyur par bsam zhing*/ slar yang oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlabs nas/ rang gi snying ga'i hūm̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas mi g.yo ba la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs pa la gtor ma phul bas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ sngags snga ma nyid kyis lan bdun du phul nas/ oṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog∶oṃ badz+ra dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ oṃ badz+ra ghan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri dang*/ oṃ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis (《 zha 》 de bzhin du dhu pe/ a lo ke gan+he/ nai we t+ye rnams kyis )zhal zas rnams phul nas/ kye kye mtha' gnyis rnam par ma g.yos ∶shing*/ /sprul pa'i gzugs kyi 'gro don dpag med mdzad/ /'jigs byed chen pos 'gro ba kun sgrol zhing*/ /srid pa gsum na dgyes pa'i gar mdzad de/ /srid pa'i chu bo skems shing mi mthun bdud rnams 'joms/ /srid pa'i rlung gis ma g.yos thugs rje mi g.yo mgon/ /rab brjid mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /ces (《 zha 》 kyang pa la sogs pas )bstod nas | 'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa'i dngos grub ∶thams cad (《 zha 》 ma lus )stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab nas/ gshegs su gsol lo/ / nyal ba'i tshe chos thams cad rang gi sems su bsdus la/ sems hūm̐ gi rnam pas nyal bar bya'o/ /ldang ba'i tshe skad cig gis lha'i nga rgyal gyis ldang bar bya'o/ /rje btsun mi g.yo ba'i sgrub pa'i thabs/

rje sa skya pa'i gsung bzhin 'phags pas sbyar ba'o// //༄༅/ /mi g.yo ba phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ tsa tur+bhu dza ār+ya a tsa la sā dha naṃ/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa mi g.yo ba phyag bzhi pa'i sgrub thabs/ mi g.yo mgon po la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dang po kho nar skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ tshangs ba'i gnas bzhi dang*/ byang chub kyi sems bsgoms nas/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhas+sarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid du bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas sngon gyi smon lam gyi stobs kyis pam̐ las pad+ma ram̐ las nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'od zer 'phros pa las mngon par grub pa'i rdo rje'i sa gzhi dang*/ ra ba dang*/ gur dang*/ bla re dang*/ rdo rje ra ba'i phyi rol du ral gri'i ra ba dang*/ de'i phyi rol du srid pa'i rtse mo la thug pa'i me 'bar ba'i phung po bsgom par bya'o/ /yang de'i dbus su pad+ma dang nyi ma'i steng du bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan pa'i gdan la/ hūm̐ gi yi ge yongs su gyur pa las/ ral gri'i chang zung la hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las/ 'od zer phar 'phros/ gdug pa thams cad btul nas/ slar 'dus te yongs su gyur pa las/ bdag nyid rje btsun mi g.yo ba/ zhal bzhi pa/ phyag bzhi pa/ g.yon dang g.yas bskum pa dang*/ brkyang ba'i zhabs bzhis bdud bzhi mnan pa/ zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum pa/ mche ba gtsigs pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos ral gri 'bar ba 'debs pa'i tshul du 'dzin cing*/ gnyis pas rdo rje gsor ba/ g.yon gyi dang pos rdo rje'i zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub thugs kar mdzad cing*/ gnyis pa khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa 'dzin pa/ sbrul gdug pa dang rus pa dang rin po che'i rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan zhing*/ mi'i lpags ba'i stod g.yogs dang*/ stag gi lpags pas smad g.yogs pa/ skra ser po gyen du 'bar zhing*/

mtshon cha sna tshogs pa 'dzin pa'i khro bo'i sprin gyi tshogs mngon par 'phro ba bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i gnas gsum du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ bkod nas/ ye shes pa dang ro gcig par byas te/ dbang bskur nas mi bskyod pas dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /de'i thugs ka'i hūm̐ gi mtha' ma sngags kyis bskor ba la yid gtad de/ na maḥ sa man+ta kā ya wāk+tsit+ta badz+ra ṇāṃ/ oṃ a tsa la ka na ka na/ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa s+pho ṭa ya hūm̐ traṃ maṃ haṃ/ bsnyen pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ tsaṇ+ḍa ma hā ro ṣa ṇa ma ma sha trūn/ a mu ka s+ya shi raṃ kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ka ti mu ka s+t+waṃ bha ya/ hṛ daṃ kī la ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ las la sbyar ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ a tsa la te dza badz+ra puṣ+pe/ dhū pe/ dī pe/ gan+dhe/ nai wi d+ye/ sa pa ri wā ra bh+yaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ paṇ+ḍi pa tra sarba sa twa ni | i maṃ ba liṃ gṛ h+ṇa gṛ h+ṇa/ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ bhak+ṣa bhak+ṣa ni hūm̐ phaṭa/ gtor ma'i sngags so/ /bsgrub bya'i rkang rjes kyi rdul las gzugs mngon par byas te/ mngon par bsngags pa'i seng ldeng gi phur pa sor bcu gnyis pas/ zhag nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du gdab pa'i las bya'o/ /phyag bzhi pa 'phags pa mi g.yo ba'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so// //༄༅/ /mi g.yo ∶ba'i (《 lu 》 ba yon tan rgyal po'i ) bstod pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swa sti sid+dhaṃ/ gang gi drin gyis bde 'gro'i 'byor pa dang*/ /rnam par grol ba'i 'bras bu mchog ster ba/ /mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal nas/ khro rgyal dad pa'i yid kyis bstod par bgyi/ /rgyal ba kun gyi thugs las rnam sprul cing*/ /zhe sdang 'joms byed 'jigs byed khro bo'i tshul/ /bdud dang gshin rje'i tshogs rnams skrag mdzad pa/ /ye shes khro bo'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /chu skyes tsha (《 lu 》 bsil )zer byed pa'i dbus su ni/ /nad brgyad rang bzhin spre'u brgyad mnan nas/ /sde brgyad 'byung po'i tshogs rnams zil gnon pa/

khro rgyal mi g.yo mgon la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /sku mdog nyi ma 'bum gyi gzi ldan zhing*/ /sprin med nam mkha'i mdangs ltar rab tu dwangs/ /ye shes me dpung dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar/ khro rgyal dpa' bo'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum tshul/ /g.yas dmar g.yon dkar dbus mthing mche ba gtsigs/ /dbu skra gyen 'khyil zhal re spyan gsum ldan | | stag dang sbrul gyis brgyan la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /g.yas pa rnams kyis ye shes ral gri dang*/ /rdo rje dang ni 'bar ba'i 'khor lo 'dzin/ /g.yon gyi dang po sdigs mdzub lhag ma yis/ /dgra sta zhags pa 'dzin la phyag 'tshal bstod/ / gsung gi nga ro rig sngags drag po'i sgra/ /'brug stong ldir ba lta bu cher bsgrags pas | | bgegs kyi tshogs kyi snying rab 'gas byed pa/ /dpa' bo chen po'i gsung la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rnam par mi rtog dus gsum mnyam pa nyid/ /srid dang zhi ba'i mtha' la mi gnas shing*/ /thugs rje chen pos 'gro ba kun skyob pa/ / mi g.yo ye shes thugs la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dad pas mgon po khyod kyi sku dran zhing

| | ngag gis rig sngags bzlas brjod rab bgyis nas/ /rtse gcig yid kyis rtag tu gsol 'debs na/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ / lus ngag yid kyis bsags pa'i sdig pa dang*/ /nad dang gdon dang bar du gcod pa dang*/ /mtshan ma ngan dang dus min 'chi la sogs/ /mi mthun phyogs kun zhi bar mdzad du gsol/ /bdag yid shin du dag par byin brlabs nas/ / mgon po khyod zhal dngos su bstan nas kyang*/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa'i phun tshogs kun/ /skad cig nyid la bdag la grub par mdzod/ khro rgyal bstod cing gsol ba btab pa las/ /dge ba rgya chen gang bsags de yis bdag / srid pa kun du khyod kyis rjes 'dzin zhing*/ /mthar thug rdzogs pa'i byang chub thob par shog /dam chos smra ba dpal ldan 'phags pa la/ /yon tan 'bum zhes bya bas gsol btab nas/ khro rgyal bstod pa'i rab tu byed pa 'di/ /me 'brug smin drug zla ba'i tshes la (《 lu 》+ gsum la/ /rgyal po'i pho brang gsar par )sbyar// //༄༅/ /rje btsunarnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs ∶stong mchod dang bcas pa (《 zha 》 - stong mchod dang bcas pa )bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /rje btsun ma rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs/ bcom ldan 'das ma rnam par rgyal ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'gro kun dga' mdzad yon tan rgyal mtshan 'dzin | | chos kyi dpal gyis srid pa gsum na gsal/ /rmad du byung ba'i phrin las bzang po can/ /mtshungs med chos kyi rje la phyag 'tshal nas/ /de yi gsung las legs par rtogs gyur nas/ /blo dman gzhan la phan par bya ba'i phyir/ / rnam par rgyal ma sgrub par byed pa'i thabs/ /bdag gis 'dir ni gsal bar bshad par bya/ /de'ang stan bde ba la skyil mo krung gis 'dug la/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su song nas/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya/ de'i don du rnam par rgyal ma bsgom snyams du byang chub kyi sems yun ring du bsgom/

rgyas par byed par 'dod na tshogs kyi zhing (《 zha 》+ mdun gyi nam mkhar )spyan drang ba dang*/ yan lag bdun pa bya/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgom | de nas/ oṃ shū n+ya tā dzñā na badz+ra swa bhā wa āt+ma ko3 haṃ/ zhes brjod la snang ba thams cad stong par bsam mo/ /de ltar stong pa'i ngang las pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas*/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas tshur 'dus nas bh+rūm̐ la thim pas/ rin po che las grub pa'i mchod rten rin po che'i khri'i steng du pad+ma/ de'i steng na khri zlum po bang rim gsum pa/ de'i steng na zla ba'i dkyil 'khor/ de'i steng du bum rten dang bcas pa'i bum pa zlum po yangs shing rgya che ba sgo dang bcas pa/ de'i steng du bre/ de'i steng du gdugs rim pa bcu gsum/ de'i steng du char khebs tog dang bcas pa me tog gi phreng ba dang*/ dar gyi lda ldis mdzes par byas par bsam mo/ /de'i nang du pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du/ bh+rūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje (《 zha 》+ lte ba la )bh+rūm̐ gyis mtshan pa/ de las 'od zer phar 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi don byas tshur 'dus nas bh+rūm̐ la thim pas/ rang nyid skad cig gis rnam par rgyal ma/ sku mdog dkar mo zhal gsum phyag brgyad ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal dkar ba/ g.yas ser ba/ g.yon sngo zhing cung zad khros pa'i tshul can/ zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos sna tshogs rdo rje thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ gnyis pas ∶pad+ma'i (《 zha 》 dkar po'i )steng na 'od dpag tu med pa bzhugs pa 'dzin pa/ gsum pas mda' dang*/ bzhi pa mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos rdo rje zhags pa dang bcas pa'i sdigs mdzub/ gnyis pas gzhu/ gsum pa skyabs sbyin gyi phyag rgya mdzad pa/ bzhi pas mnyam gzhag gi steng na bum pa 'dzin pa | skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/

rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi na bza' can du rang bskyed do/ /de'i g.yas su spyan ras gzigs dkar po/ phyag g.yas pas rnga yab/ g.yon pas pad+ma 'dzin pa/ g.yon du phyag na rdo rje/ sngon po phyag g.yas pas rnga yab/ g.yon pas rdo rje 'dzin pa/ gnyis ka'ang zhi ba'i cha lugs can/ rin po che'i rgyan sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa/ dar sna tshogs kyi sham thabs can du bsam/ de nas shar phyogs su mi g.yo ba sngon po/ phyag g.yas pas ral gri 'dzin pa/ lho phyogs su 'dod pa'i rgyal po g.yas pas lcags kyu 'dzin pa/ nub phyogs su dbyug pa sngon po can/ g.yas pas dbyug pa 'dzin pa/ byang phyogs su stobs po che/ g.yas pas rdo rje rtse gsum pa 'dzin pa/ thams cad kyang mdog sngon po rab tu khros pa/ g.yon pa snying gar sdigs mdzub byas pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs pa'o/ /gtso mo'i steng gi phyogs gnyis nas gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu gnyis kyis rin po che'i bum pa bdud rtsi'i chus gang bas/ bcom ldan 'das ma la sku khrus gsol bar bsam mo/ /de thams cad kyi spyi bor oṃ dkar po/ mgrin par āḥdamar po/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po/ dpral bar trām̐ ser po/ lte bar hrīḥdamar po/ brla gnyis la aṃ aḥ zhes pa ljang gu gnyis bsgom mo/ /de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas rje btsun ma 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs la | ar+ghaṃ pād+yaṃ badz+ra puṣ+pe la sogs pa'i mchod pas mchod/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dzā yai sa pa ri wā ra/ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod pas bdag gis bsgoms pa'i lha'i tshogs dang gnyis su med par bstim mo/ /yang 'od zer 'phros pas de bzhin gshegs pa rigs lnga 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs/∶mchod pas (《 zha 》 yud tsam )mchod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la (《 zha 》+ mngon par

)dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas lus ngag yid gsum gyi dri ma dag chu lhag ma yar lud pas gtso mo la rnam par snang mdzad/ spyan ras gzigs la 'od dpag med/ phyag na rdo rje dang*/ khro bo bzhi la mi bskyod pa/ lha'i bu gnyis la rin chen 'byung ldan gyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /de nas rang gi snying gar pad+ma dang zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du bh+rūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje shar dkar/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang*/ lte ba sngon po'i nang du bh+rūm̐ gyi steng du bla ma/ mdun dang g.yas g.yon rgyab rnams su gang bsrung bar bya ba rnams bsgoms la/ de rnams kyi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng bas bskor ba la dmigs la/ gzungs ring dang*/ snying po/ nye snying rnams bzla'o/ /de'i rjes su/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ am̐ aḥche ge mo la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ zhes bzlas par bya'o/ /bzlas pa tshar nas/ ye shes pa la bzod par gsol la gshegs su gsol/ de dag gis ni bdag nyid kyis bsgoms pa'i mngon par rtogs pa bstan zin to/(《 zha 》+ oṃ bh+ruṃ swa hā/ oṃ a mṛ ta ā yur dat+te swā hā/ )/gal te rang ngam gzhan gyi don du/ tshes brgyad (《 zha 》+ dam bco lnga )la sogs pa la stong mchod byed par 'dod pas/ maṇ+ḍal gru bzhi pa'i steng du/ tshon rtsi dkar pos pad+ma ∶'dab ma (《 zha 》 - 'dab ma )brgyad pa bris la/ de'i dbus su bum pa mgul chings dang*/ kha rgyan dang bcas pa chu dang bcud rnams kyis yongs su gang ba bzhag nas/ de'i steng du mchod rten tshad dang ldan pa bzhugs la/ de'i mtha' mar/ mchod yon/(《 zha 》+ zhabs bsil/ )me tog∶spos/(《 zha 》 - spos/ )mar me | (《 zha 》+ dri chab/ )lha bshos/(《 zha 》+ rol mo )gdugs/∶ba dan (《 zha 》 'phan )rnams/ stong phrag re re dang*/ gzhan yang mchod ∶pa'i yo byad (《 zha 》 pa )ci 'byor pa bsham mo/ /gtor ma stong gi chas kyang byas nas/ sgrub pa po grogs dang bcas pas khrus bya'o/

/dkon mchog gi spyan sngar gso sbyong rang gis blang ba'i cho ga byas nas | rnal 'byor dang rnal 'byor chen po'i lugs ltar na/ bdag bskyed rdzogs par bsgom/ bya ba'i rgyud la bdag bskyed mi dgos/ spyod pa'i rgyud la bsgoms nas gshegs su gsol(《 zha 》+ bar bya'o/ )/ de nas bum pa dang mchod par bcas pa/ oṃ a mṛ ∶te (《 zha 》 ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na )hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces pas bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod la stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod pa rnams lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad dwangs shing thogs pa med pa bsam gyis mi khyab par byin gyis brlab/ bum pa stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya cher bar bsam/ de'i steng du mchod rten gyi nang du rang gis ji ltar bsgoms pa lta bu'i lha dgu bskyed/ gnas bdun du yig 'bru bdun gyi byin gyis brlabs nas/ bdag dang de'i thugs ka'i bh+rūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas/ rang bzhin gyi gnas nas bcom ldan 'das ma (《 zha 》+ rnam par rgyal ma )la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor ba spyan drang bar bsam zhing*/ 'di skad ces/ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing | | bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha/ /dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa/ /bcom ldan rnam rgyal 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol | | oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dzā yai sa pa ri wā ra sa mā dzaḥ∶dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ(《 zha 》 - dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ )zhes lan gsum brjod pas mdun gyi nam mkha'i gnas su byon par bsams nas/ mchod pa lngas mchod la/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dzā yai | sa pa ri wā ra ∶sa mā dzaḥ(《 zha 》 - sa mā dzaḥ )dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod pas/ mdun bskyed dang gnyis su med par bstim mo/(《 zha 》+ de nas bdag bskyed bzhin du dbang bskur la dbu brgyan par bsam mo/

/ )/de'i thugs kar pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du/ bh+rūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje'i lte ba stong pa'i nang du bh+rūm̐ gyi steng dang phyogs kun tu bsrung bya rnams dmigs nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ trām̐ hrīḥ aṃ aḥche ge mo la rak+ṣa rak+ṣa ku ru swā hā/ zhes lan gsum mam bdun brjod do/ /de nas mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bya ste/ so so'i phyag rgya dang bcas pas/ oṃ sarba ∶ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa bi dzā yai sa pa ri wā ra (《 zha 》 nas bar sngon du btang la/ )ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ zhes bya bas mchod yon dang*/ de bzhin du ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su pā d+yaṃ gis zhabs bsil dang*/ puṣ+paṃ gyi me tog dhū paṃ gyis bdug spos/ dī paṃ gyis mar me/ gan+dhaṃ gyis dri(《 zha 》+ chab dang )/ nai wi d+yes zhal zas/ shap+tas rol mo/ tsha traṃ gis gdugs/∶pa taṃ kas (《 zha 》 pā taṃ gis )lda ldi rnams kyis mchod nas gzungs kyi bzlas pa bya ste/ rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas bcom ldan 'das ∶ma 'khor dang bcas pa' ི rgyud bskul bas (《 zha 》 ma'i thugs kar phog nas thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas )bsgrub bya rnams byin gyis rlob cing | ba spu'i bu ga nas bdud rtsi'i rgyun zags pas/ bum pa'i nang yongs su gang bar bsam la/ legs so sbyin pa'i phyag rgya bcas nas gzungs lan gcig brjod do/ /de nas phyag rgya mi byed par stong rdzogs par bya'o/ /de yang na mo zhes lan re brjod pa'i tshe/ mgo 'dud pa'i phyag re bya'o/ /bskor ba stong yang grub par bya'o/ /de nyid dang rjes su 'brel par gtor ma stong yang bya ste/ a kā ro'i sngags kyis 'khor ba dang mya ngan las 'das pa thams cad la gtang ngo*/ / gzungs rdzogs pa'i mthar/ phyogs skyong dang 'byung po la dpung pa bzang po las byung ba'i gtor ma'i cho gas gtor ma sbyin no/ /de nas slar yang bcom ldan 'das ma la mchod nas/ bstod pa rgyas pa ni gzhan ltar bya'o/ /bsdus pa ni/

dpal ldan lha mo ston ka'i zla ba'i mdog /zhal gsum phyag brgyad rab mdzes zhi ba'i sku/ /ye shes dpag yas tshe yi mchog stsol ma/ /rnam par rgyal ma'i zhabs phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhes bstod nas/ dngos grub blang*/ ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang | | gang yang bdag rmongs blo yis ni/ /bgyis pa dang ni bgyid stsal ba/ /de kun mgon pos bzod par mdzod/ /ces pas bzod par gsol nas/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu bsngo'o/ /yon bdag gis 'bul ba dang bsnyen bkur bya'o/ /mchod rdzas rnams phongs pa la sbyin no/ /de ltar byas na/ blo rno ba dang | tshe ring ba dang*/ nad med pa la sogs pa mthong chos kyi phan yon dang*/ 'chi ba'i dus byas pa de'i tshe/ bde ba can gyi 'jig rten gyi khams su skye ba la sogs pa rnam par smin pa'i ∶yon tan (《 zha 》 phan yon )dpag tu med pa 'byung ngo*// bum pa'i chus khrus byas pa tsam gyis kyang*/ nad med pa la sdig pa sel ba la sogs pa'i phan yon mang du 'byung ngo*/ /rtog pa gnyis kyi rjes 'brangs nas/ /bla ma'i man ngag gis brgyan pa'i/ /sgrub thabs 'di ni 'phags pas bsdebs/ / dge des kun mkhyen thob par shog /∶rnam par rgyal ma'i sgrub thabs rdzogs so || || (《 zha 》 shing pho stag gi lo la bris/ ) ༄༅/ /gdugs dkar mo can sgrub thabs gzungs bklag thabs dang bcas pa bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la spyi bos phyag 'tshal lo/ /bcom ldan 'das ma gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo can bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs su 'gro ba dang*/ tshad med pa bzhi dang*/ byang chub kyi sems bsgoms nas/ swa bhā wa'i sngags kyis stong par bsams pa'i ngang las/ pam̐ las pad+ma/ ram̐ las nyi ma'i steng du/ hūm̐ las sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis/ rdo rje'i sa gzhi/ ra ba/ dra ba/ gur/ bla re/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i srung 'khor bsgoms pa'i nang du bgegs dang log 'dren thams cad mnan pa'i pad+ma dang nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su rang gi shes pa oṃ las 'khor lo dkar po oṃ gyis mtshan pa las 'od zer phar 'phros/

sems can gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus pa'i tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gtsug tor nas byung ba'i gdugs dkar mo can gyi gsang sngags kyi yi ge'i tshogs dpag tu med pa spyan drangs pa dang*/ lhan cig 'dus shing ro gcig tu gyur pa las byung ba'i rang nyid gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo can/ sku mdog dkar mo zhabs g.yas pa cung zad brkyang nas bsgyings pa'i tshul du bzhugs pa/ zhi ba dang*/ sgeg pa dang*/ khro ba la sogs pa'i nyams du ma dang ldan zhing kha dog sna tshogs pa'i dbu stong mnga' ba/ skyabs sbyin dang*/ mi 'jigs pa dang*/ mchog sbyin pa dang*/ rdo rje khu tshur dang*/ sdigs mdzub la sogs pa'i phyag rgya sna tshogs bcas shing*/ rdo rje dang | 'khor lo dang*/ nor bu dang*/ pad+ma dang*/ ral gri dang / mda' dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ tho ba dang*/ zhags pa la sogs pa phyag mtshan du ma 'dzin pa'i phyag stong mnga' ba chen mo/ sku'i cha thams cad la 'dzum pa dang*/ zur gyis lta ba dang*/ rnam par bgrad pa dang*/ glog ltar 'khyug pa'i spyan bye ba brgya stong mnga' ba/ rdo rje'i rang bzhin ltar mi phyed pa'i sku dus mtha'i me ltar 'bar zhing*/ kun tu mched pa'i 'od zer gyi rtse mo la khro bo dang khro mo du ma'i sprul pa'i tshogs 'phros pas bgegs dang logs par 'dren pa'i tshogs 'joms shing*/ sgrub pa po la dngos grub du ma stsol ba'i rtags dang mtshan ma can ma/ sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i mthu thogs pa med cing yangs pa chen pos sa gsum gyi dkyil 'khor la mnga' mdzad ma

| de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis dbang bskur zhing*/ byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs thams cad kyis rim gror byed pa/ 'jig rten skyong ba'i tshogs thams cad kyis mchod cing rjed la/ bka' rjes su bsgrub pa'i phyir yongs su bskor bar bsam par bya'o/ /'bring la dga' bas ni/ zhal gsum phyag drug pa bsgom par bya ste/ sku mdog dang rtsa ba'i zhal dkar zhing*/ 'dzum khro'i rnam pa can | zhal g.yas sngo zhing khro la g.yon zhal dmar zhing 'dzum pa/ zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas pa gsum na rdo rje dang*/ mda' dang*/ lcags kyu dang*/ g.yon gsum na sdigs mdzub dang*/ zhags pa dang*/ gzhu bsnams pa bsgom mo/ /bsdus pa la dga' bas ni phyag gnyis ma/ sku mdog dkar mo rdo rje'i skyil mo krung gis bzhugs pa/ phyag g.yas pas mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya mdzad cing*/ g.yon pas bdag nyid yul 'khor srid 'bangs dang bcas pa khebs pa'i gdugs dkar po bsnams pa/ nyams dang cha lugs thams cad snga ma ltar bsgom par bya'o/ /de nas sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlab cing | ye shes kyi 'khor lo dgug gzhug byas nas/ dbang gi lha sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad spyan drangs la me tog la sogs pas mchod de/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shri ye hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ dbang gi chus lus thams cad gang | sangs rgyas thams cad dang nus pa mnyam par byas/ chu lhag ma yar lud pas/ rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /de'i thugs kar nyi ma'i steng du oṃ bsgoms pa'i khor yug tu sngags kyi phreng ba 'khor ba'i 'od kyis 'phags pa mchod/ phrin las bzhis sems can gyi don byas/ khyad par du gdug pa can rnams tshar bcad par bsam zhing sngags bzla ste/

tad+ya thā/ oṃ a na le/ a na le/ kha sa me/ kha sa me/ bai ra bai ra/ sau me sau me/ sarba bud+dhā a dhiṣ+ṭhā na/ a dhiṣ+ṭhi te/ sarba ta thā ga ta uṣ+ṇī ṣa si tā ta pa tre hūm̐ phaṭa/ hūm̐ ma ma hūm̐ ni swā hā/ zhes ci nus pa bzla'o/ /'di la bsnyen pa song ba dang*/ las kyi sngags ni gzungs ring nyid yin te/ de zlo bar 'dod pas rang gi sku'i cha nas 'phros pa'i mtshon du ma thogs pa'i khro bo dang khro mo'i tshogs dpag tu med pas pha rol gyi rig sngags kyi zhags pa bcad nas sngags sbyor ba po dang*/ zlo ba po phur bus btab pa dang mnan par bsam zhing*/ oṃ si tā ta la sogs pa'i sngags ci nus su bzlas so// bzlas pa tshar ba dang*/ ye shes pa mdun gyi nam mkhar phyung ba la mchod cing bstod nas bzod par gsol te/ badz+ra muḥs gshegs su gsol la/ rang dam tshig pa'i nga rgyal gyis gnas par bya'o/ /bum pa'i cho ga byed pa na/ pad+ma 'dab brgyad kyi steng du bca' thabs gzhan dang 'dra bar byas la/ de'i nang du bdag bskyed ltar cho ga rgyas par byas te/ bzlas pa byas pas sku las bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs par bsam/ mchod bstod bkra shis la sogs pa byas te/ longs spyad na/ yams nad la sogs pa 'di nyid kyi gzhung nas bshad pa'i gnod pa rnams las rgyal bar 'gyur ro/ /'di'i gtor ma ni/ dkar gtor dang dmar gtor gnyis bshams nas sngags drug phyag rgya drug gam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor byin gyis brlabs nas/ bsngo yul rnams mdun du bsam la/ bcom ldan 'das ma sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang bcas pa dang*/ 'jig rten pa dkar gsum la dga' ba rnams la dkar gtor dang*/ sha khrag la dga' ba rnams la dmar gtor 'bul bar bsam zhing*/ sngags ring gsum mam bdun la sogs pa bzla'o/ /gleng gzhi dang bcas pa'i gzungs rgyas par 'don par 'dod na/ 'di nyid kyi skabs su 'don par bya ste/ bdag gis gzungs bton pa'i tshe gtor ma'i mgron bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pa thams cad kyi rgyud bskul bas ji skad brjod pa'i don bsgrub par bsam zhing 'don par bya'o/

/ mthar mchod cing bstod la bzod par gsol te/ gshegs su gsol lo/ /cho ga rgyas pa las kyi tshogs dang bcas pa gzhan du shes par bya'o/ /rje btsun ba ri lo tsā ba las brgyud pa/ rje sa skya pa'i man ngag gtsug tor gdugs dkar mo can gyi bsgom thabs dang bklag pa'i thabs/ shing phag khra zla'i tshes nyi shu'i nyin par 'phags pas trai'i sa char bsdebs pa'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra zhes bya'o// //༄༅/ /ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub thabs ∶gzungs chog dang bcas pa (《 zha 》 dang bum chog )bzhugs/ / ༄༅/ /rje btsun ma ri khrod lo ma can gyi sgrub pa'i thabs zhes bya ba/ ri khrod gnas su ri khrod ma'i/ /rnam par 'phrul pa kun 'phrul (《 zha 》 sprul )nas/ / 'gro ba'i rims sogs sel mdzad pa/ /ri khrod lo ma can la 'dud/ /ri khrod dpal mo mnyes byas pas/ /'jig rten 'jig rten 'das pa yi/ /dngos grub ma lus thob bya'i phyir/ /de yi bsgrub pa'i rim pa bshad/ /de la 'di'am gzhan gyi dkyil 'khor du dbang bskur ba thob pa'am/ yang na smon pa dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed pa thob cing*/ 'di'i gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa'i lung thob pa | 'di bsgom par 'dod pas stan bde ba la bsdad/ bla ma dang dkon mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro bar bya/ sems can thams cad kyi don du sangs rgyas thob par bya ∶ba'i (《 zha 》 de don )don du/ 'phags ma ri khrod lo ma can bsgom snyam du byang chub kyi sems bskyed/ de nas rang gi snying gi nang du pad+ma dang zla ba'i steng du bsgom par bya ba'i lha'i kha dog can gyi pam̐ las 'od 'phros pas rang bzhin gyi gnas nas lha mo ri khrod lo ma can gyi dbu rgyan du bla ma mi bskyod ba'i rnam ∶pa can du (《 zha 》 par )bzhugs pa la/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs la/ na mo gu ru bh+yaḥs bla ma dang*/ namaḥ par+ṇa sha wa r+yai | zhes pas lha mo la phyag 'tshal nas/ rang gi snying ga nas sprul pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis mchod par bsam zhing*/

oṃ par+ṇa sha wa r+yai/ zhes kun la sbyar la/ ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hās mchod yon/ pā d+yaṃ pra tīts+tsha (《 zha 》+ ye )swā hās zhabs bsil/ badz+ra puṣ+pe āḥhūm̐ gis me tog badz+ra d+dhū pe āḥhūm̐ gis bdug spos/ badz+ra ā lo ke āḥhūm̐ gis mar me/ badz+ra gan+dhe āḥhūm̐ gis dri/ badz+ra nai wi d+ye āḥhūm̐ gis zhalazas/ badz+ra shab+da āḥhūm̐ gis rol mo phul nas/ dkon mchog gsum la bdag skyabs mchi/ / sdig pa thams cad so sor bshags/ /'gro ba'i dge la rjes yi rangs/ /sangs rgyas byang chub yid kyis gzung*/ /zhes don bsams bzhin pas lan gsum brjod nas/ sems can thams cad bde bar gyur cig sdug bsngal dang bral bar gyur cig bde ba dang mi 'bral bar gyur cig sems can thams cad mnyam pa nyid la gnas par gyur cig ces tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms pas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs bsags/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas/ bdag dang snang ba thams cad mi dmigs pa'i stong ∶par (《 zha 》 nyid du )bsgom/ stong pa'i ngang las (《 zha 》+ paṃ las )rin po che'i ri bo ljon shing sna tshogs pa'i nags tshal dang me tog gi tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i steng du/ pam̐ las pad+ma a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi ∶steng du (《 zha 》 dbus su )rang gi shes pa pam̐ gyi yi ge gser gyi mdog can du bsam/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ sems can gyi don byas/ khyad par du nad dang sdug bsngal thams cad bsal/ slar 'dus nas pam̐ la thim zhing de yongs su gyur pa las bdag nyid bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod lo ma can du gyur pa ni sku mdog gser btso ma lta bu/ zhabs g.yas pa'i rting pas 'og gi phyogs brten zhing pus mo gdan la btsugs pa/ g.yas pas bzhengs stabs su mdzad pa/ rnam par bsgyings pa'i stabs kyis bzhugs pa/ zhal gsum phyag drug ma/ rtsa ba'i zhal ser zhing 'dzum khro'i rnam pa can/ g.yas pa'i zhal dkar zhing zhi ba/

g.yon pa dmar zhing chags pa'i nyams can/ zhal re re zhing spyan gsum gsum dang ldan pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang pos thugs kar rdo rje dang | gnyis pas dgra sta 'debs pa'i tshul dang*/ gsum pas mda' gsor zhing 'dzin pa/ g.yon gyi dang pos sdigs mdzub la rdo rje zhags pas dkris pa/ gnyis pas me tog dang 'bras bus spud pa'i shing lo gsar pa'i sbrang g.yab dang*/ gsum pas gzhu 'dzin pa/ rin po che du ma dang me tog sna tshogs pa'i rgyan gyis spras shing*/ lha rdzas kyi na bza' dmar po'i stod g.yogs can/ me tog dang 'bras bu du mas spras pa'i shing lo gsar pa gshibs pa'i smad g.yogs can/ rab tu zhi zhing mdzes pa/ sbrul dkar pos se ral khar byas pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs gyen du bcings shing*/ lang tsho la bab pa'i sku/ shin tu mdzes shing grims la | cung zad khro ba'i tshul can du bsgom par bya'o/ /yang na phyag gnyis par (《 zha 》 ma )bsam par bya ste/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas pas rdo rje dang bcas pa'i khu tshur gyis bgegs kyi tshogs la bsnun par mdzad cing*/ g.yon pa thugs kar sdigs mdzub mdzad pas gnod par byed pa thams cad kun du gzir ba/ dmar la zlum pa'i spyan gsum dang ldan zhing khro gnyer bsdus pa/ mche ba rnam par gtsigs shing lto ba 'phyangs pa/ sku thung zhing sbom la brjid pa/ dbu skra ser po gyen du 'bar ba/ rus pa dang rin po che dang sbrul gdug pa'i rgyan gyis brgyan cing*/ stag gi lpags pa'i sham thabs can/ bskal pa'i me lta bu'i ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus su bsgom par bya'o/ /yang na phyag bzhi pa bsgom par bya ste/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi ma sku mdog ston ka'i nam mkha' ltar sngo zhing dwangs pa | phyag g.yas kyi dang po mchog sbyin gyi phyag rgyas/ lha'i dpag bsam gyi shing las 'khrungs pa'i 'bras bus 'gro ba'i nad thams cad sel bar mdzad pa yin zhing | gnyis pas dgra sta bsnams pas gdug pa can rnams la bsnun par mdzad pa/

g.yon gyi dang pos rdo rje'i zhags pas bgegs kyi tshogs 'ching zhing*/ gnyis pas nor bu'i yu ba can gyi rnga yab dkar pos gdul bya rnams kyi nad sel bar mdzad pa/ shin tu mdzes pa'i sku/ sgeg pa dang khro ba'i nyams can/ zhi ba dang drag po'i rgyan ∶thams cad kyis (《 zha 》 gyis )brgyan zhing*/ shing lo gsar pa rnam par bkram pa'i stod g.yogs dang*/ stag gi lpags pa'i smad g.yogs mnabs pa | g.yas cung zad bskum zhing g.yon brkyang pa'i stabs kyis bzhengs pa/ nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi rgyab yol can du bsgom par bya'o/ /'di dag dus gcig la gsum ka bsgom par bya ba ni ma yin te/ gang la mos pa de bsgom par bya'o/ /de ltar bsgoms pa'i dpral bar oṃ dkar po dang*/ mgrin par āḥdamar po dang*/ snying gar hūm̐ sngon po dang*/ snying gi nang du nyi ma la gnas pa'i pam̐ rang gi kha dog dang mthun par bsgom par bya'o/ /de ∶nas pam̐ (《 zha 》 - nas pam̐ )las sna tshogs pa'i 'od zer 'phros pas rang bzhin gya ི gnas nas rje btsun ma ri khrod lo ma gyon pa (《 zha 》 ma )la sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis bskor ba mdun gyi nam mkha' la spyan drangs pa la sngar bzhin mchod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod pas rang dang gnyis su med par bstim mo/ /yang pam̐ gyi yi ge de nyid las 'od zer dpag tu med pa spros pas dbang gi lha de bzhin gshegs pa 'khor dang bcas pa spyan drangs pa la snga ma ltar mchod nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bdag la mngon par dbang bskur du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas | sangs rgyas de rnams kyis/ ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni/ /lha rnams kyis ni khrus gsol ltar/ /lha yi chu ni dag pa yis/ /de bzhin bdag gis dbang bskur ro/ /oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shṝ hūm̐/ zhes gsung zhing bum pa'i chus spyi bo nas dbang bskur bas/ lus thams cad gang*/ dri ma thams cad dag

gsang sngags dang phrin las thams cad la dbang bar byas/ chu lhag ma spyi bor lud pas/ dbang rtags su gyur pa ni/ phyag drug ma la mi bskyod pa/ gnyis pa la 'od dpag tu med pa/ bzhi pa la don yod grub (《 zha 》+ sa dbu rgyan )par blta'o// de nas lha'i sku snang la rang bzhin med pa me long gi nang gi gzugs brnyan lta bu la ∶rang gi (《 zha 》 - rang gi )sems gtad nas mnyam par bzhag go /gang gi tshe sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ de'i tshe snying gi nang gi pam̐ gyi mtha' mar sngags kyi phreng ba g.yas phyogs su 'khor ba'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyi rgyud bskul bas bdag gi rgyud byin gyis rlob cing*/ bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa dang nad thams cad bsal bar bsams la/ oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha wa rī sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma ṇā ya swā hā/ zhes ci nus pa bzla bar bya ste/ snying ∶po'i sngags so(《 zha 》 po'o )/ /oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha ba rī hrīḥha (《 zha 》 dza )hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni nye ba'i snying po'o/ /'di'i rtsa ba'i sngags zlo bar 'dod na/ gzungs nyid nas 'byung ∶ba bzhin bzla bar bya'o(《 zha 》 ngo )// bsnyen pa'i grangs ni/ rtsa ba'i sngags 'bum phrag gcig snying po 'bum phrag nyi shu/ yang snying 'bum phrag bco lngas ji skad bshad pa'i las thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa'i cho ga'o/ /de nas rang dang gzhan gyi don du bum pa'i cho ga byed par 'dod pas/ ba byung lnga dang dri bzang pos byugs pa'i maṇ+ḍal la tshon rtsi dkar pos pad+ma 'dab ma brgyad pa bris pa'i dbus dang*/ 'dab ma brgyad la me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa'i dbus su bum pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ dar ram ras dkar po'i mgul chings prog lnga'am/ bdun dang ldan pas bcing*/ 'bras bu can gyi shing gi rtse mo ma nyams pa'i chun pos kha brgyan no/(《 zha 》 pa )/rin po che lnga dang*/ sman lnga/ dri lnga/

snying po lnga/ 'bru lnga dang bcas pa'i chu gtsang mas bkang ba bzhag pa'i steng du/ rin po che'i sder ∶ma 'brus (《 zha 》 'bras bus )gang ba'i nang du/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel dang*/ 'di nyid kyi gzungs bzhugs shing*/ rab gnas dang ldan pa'i mchod rten bzhugs su gzhug de'i steng du gdugs dkar po dbub/ phyogs bzhir me tog dkar po'i phreng ba re gdags/ bre'am tog la gzungs thag kyang bcing ngo*/ khor yug tu chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang*/ gzhan yang mchod rdzas kyis bskor/ sman dang*/ dkar gsum mngar gsum gyis brgyan pa'i gtor ma dang*/ dmar gtor dang*/ yang dkar gtor gsum dang*/ dmar gtor gnyis dang*/ dkar gtor gcig(《 zha 》+ gzhi bdag la )gang 'os pa'i gtor ma gcig ste gtor ma dgu bsham mo/ /de nas rang nyid khrus byas/ gos gtsang ma gyon/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal nas gso sbyong blangs la/ gong du bstan pa ltar bdag bskyed bsgaums la bzlas pa ci rigs pa bya'o/ /de nas dri bzangs kyi chu ku shas bum pa dang ∶mchod pa (《

zha 》 gtor ma )rnams la gtor zhing*/ oṃ (《 zha 》+ badz+ra )a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas ma dag pa bsangs/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥ sarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ zhes brjod pas thams cad stong par bsam/ stong pa'i ngang las mchod rdzas rnams/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las lha rdzas las grub pa'i mchod pa ngo bo bzang zhing rgya che ba dpag tu med pa bskyed nas so so'i sngags kyi byin gyis brlab bo/ /mchod rdzas rnams kyi dbus su pam̐ las pad+ma/ a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ (《 zha 》 bh+ruṃ )las rin po che'i bum pa lto ba yangs shing mgrin pa phra ba/ dpag bsam gyi shing gis kha brgyan zhing lha rdzas kyi gos kyis mgul pa dkris pa'i steng du bh+rūm̐ las rin po che'i mchod rten ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa/ rgyan thams cad gyis spras pa/ yangs shing rgya che ba bskyed la/ mchod rten gyi bum pa'i nang du sngar bshad pa'i tshul gyis bcom ldan 'das ma ri khrod lo ma can/ yan lag bzhi rdzogs su bskyed do/ /de'i phyi rol gyi steng du/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dang*/ khor yug tu chos skyong ba'i srung ma dang*/ 'jig rten pa thams cad kyis bskor bar blta'o/ /de dag gong du bstan pa'i mchod pa rnams kyis rim pa bzhin du mchod par bsam zhing*/ 'jig rten khams 'di dpag med na/ /mchod yon ji snyed yod pa dang*/ /bdag gis gus par bshams pa 'di/ /ri khrod lo ma gyon ma dang | | rgyal ba 'khor dang bcas la 'bul/ /bdag cag 'khor dang bcas rnams kyi/ /nad dang bgegs rnams zhi ba dang*/ /dngos grub ma lus stsal du gsol | | oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta par+ṇa sha wa rī sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha pū dza me gha sa mu dra s+pha ra ṇa sa ma ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas mchod yon/ de bzhin du mchod yon gyi gnas su zhabs bsil dang*/ ar+ghaṃ gyi gnas su pā d+yaṃ gis zhal bsil dang*/

me tog dang*/ puṣ+paṃ/ bdug spaus dang*/ dhū paṃ/ mar me dang*/∶dī pam̐/(《 zha 》 ā lo ke )dri chab dang*/ ghan+dhaṃ/ zhal zas dang*/ nai wi d+ye/ sil snyan dang*/ shab+da/ zhes pa rnams kyis mchod nas/ rgyal ba kun gyi ye shes sgyu ma yis/ /cho 'phrul rnam par 'phrul pa las byung ba'i/ /lha mo gang gis sgrub po'i nad gdon bgegs/ /kun nas zhi mdzad khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /zhing dang yul rnams kun du rnam 'phrul zhing*/ khyad par ri khrod gnas su rnam rol nas/ /sgrub pa po la dngos grub kun stsol ba// ri khrod dbang phyug ma la phyag 'tshal lo/ /sna tshogs zhal dang phyag zhabs sna tshogs dang*/ /sna tshogs mdog dang sna tshogs cha lugs dang*/ /sna tshogs rgyan dang sna tshogs phyag mtshan gyis/ /rnam par sgeg pa khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ khyad par gang gis 'dul ba'i dus (《 zha 》 thabs )mkhyen nas/ /me tog 'bras bu du mas rnam spud pa'i/ /shing lo gsar pa'i na bzas rab klubs pa/ /lo ma gyon ma khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsung gi rig sngags zhi ba'i nga ro yis/ /'gro ba'i rims dang sdug bsngal zhi mdzad cing*/ /drag po'i gsang sngags 'brug ltar cher bsgrags pas | | gdug pa 'joms mdzad de (《 zha 》 gsung )la phyag 'tshal lo/ /nyid thugs zhi bas 'gro ba zhi mdzad cing*/ /brtse bas rjes chags dga' ba chen po yis/ /tshe dang dpal 'byor rnam par rgyas mdzad ma/ /rnam grol yangs pa'i thugs mnga' khyod la 'dud/ /sgrub dang bzlas brjod brtson pas khyod kyi thugs/ /bskul bas bdag la brtse bas nyer dgongs nas/ /bgegs dang nad sogs sdug bsngal zhi ba dang*/ /tshe dang dpal 'byor rgyas par mdzad du gsol/ /skye ba kun du bdag gi mgon mdzad de/ /nyam nga'i 'jigs pa kun las bskyab pa dang*/ /srid zhi'i bde dga' rgya mtshos rab 'byor zhing*/ /rdzogs sangs yon tan rgya mtshor 'gyur bar mdzod | | ces pas bstod cing gsol ba gdab bo/ /gzhan yang ji ltar 'dod pa'i don rnams gsol ba gdab par bya'o/

/de nas bsgrub pa'i grogs dang bcas pas gzungs thag bzung la/ rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas gzungs thag la brten nas song bas bcom ldan 'das ma'i rgyud bskul bas | sku'i cha (《 zha 》+ thams cad )las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgyun dpag tu med pa babs pas bum pa'i nang gang ba dang*/ 'od zer gyi tshogs 'phros pas/ bdag dang sems can gyi rims nad dang bgegs dang 'byung po thams cad kyi gnod sems zhi bar bsam zhing*/ 'di'i snying po'i sngags gtso bor bzla'o/ /rtsa sngags dang nye ba'i snying po'ang ci rigs par bzla bar bya'o/ /thun gyi mthar mchod cing bstod la gtor ma gtang bar bya ste/ de'ang gtor ma rnams sbyangs la/ thog mar a mṛ tas bsangs/ swa bhā wās sbyangs nas/ om̐ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ las kha dog dang ro dang nus pa phun sum tshogs pa ye shes kyi bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por bskyed la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlabs la/ bcom ldan 'das ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i zhal du bstabs pas gsol bar bsam zhing*/ rdo rje thal mo kha gyen du phye la/ oṃ pi shā tsi par+ṇa sha wa rī sa pa ri wā ra i daṃ ba ling gh+ri h+na pa ya gh+ri h+nā pa ya/ sarba dz+wa ra pra sha ma ṇā ya swā hā/ zhes gsum mam bdun gyis phul la/ mchod yon la sogs pas mchod nas bstod la/ 'dod pa'i don gsol ba gdab bo/ /de nas (《 zha 》+ yang ) gnyis pa chos skyong dang*/ gsum pa phyogs skyong dang*/ bzhi pa 'byung po dang*/ lnga pa klu rnams dang*/ drug pa mkha' 'gro spy-i gtor gyis gtang ngo*/ /bdun pa gdon rigs kyi bdag po nag po'i phyogs sha khrag la dga' ba rnams la/ a kā ro'i sngags ∶kyi bsngos la drag po'i sngags kyis bskrad/(《 zha 》 dang )brgyad pa dkar po la dga' ba rnams la/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta'i sngags kyis bsngos la/ chos kyi sbyin pa byin nas mi nad dang phyugs nad

thams cad zhi bar gyur cig ces bsgo'o// dgu pa gzhi bdag dkar dang dmar la gang dga' ba de la a kā ro'i sngags kyis sbyin no/ /de nas mchod rten gyi nang na gnas pa'i lha 'khor dang bcas pa la mchod cing bstod nas gsol ba btab la bzod par gsol te/ gtor ma'i mgron rnams gshegs su gsol lo/ /de lta bu thun gsum mam bzhi la sogs pa'i rim pas/ zhag gsum mam bdun nam nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bar du bsgrub pa byas pa'i mthar/ bzod par gsol zhing yi ge brgya pas kha bskangs la/ dge ba'i rtsa ba rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas su bsngo bar bya'o/ /bum pa'i steng du mchod rten yod na gshegs su gsol mi dgos shing*/ gal te mchod rten med na bum pa'i nang ngam steng du lha bskyed par bya'o/ /mthar ye shes pa gshegs su gsol nas/ dam tshig pa zhu ba las byung ba'i bum pa'i chur blta'o/ /bsgrub ∶bya nyung ngu'i (《 zha 》 bya'i )don byed na dngos su bkru zhing*/ ku sha la sogs pas spyi bo nas gtor la/ khrus kyi tshigs bcad dang*/ sngags rim pa bzhin brjod par bya'o/ /skye bo mang po dang | grong khyer dang*/ rta phyugs la sogs ∶pa mang po'i (《 zha 》 pa'i )don byed na/ shin tu gtsang zhing mtho ba'i sa phyogs su me long chen po la de dag gi gzugs brnyan 'char du bcug la/ gtor mas bsgrub bya de dag la bskor zhing*/ oṃ sarba bigh+nā naṃ maḥ sarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ ud+ga te/ s+pha ra ṇa i mam ga ga na khaṃ gh+ri h+ne daṃ ba liṃ te swā hā/ zhes ∶bya ba'i sngags (《 zha 》 pa )dang bcas pas gsum mam bdun la sogs pas de dag la gnod par byed pa rnams la byin la/ skye bo 'di dag la gnod par byed pa'i bgegs dang 'byung po'i tshogs thams cad gtor ma 'dis tshim par gyis la/ sa'i phyogs 'dir ma gnas par song shig ces brjod la/ drag po'i sngags dang rol mo'i sgra drag tu bya'o/ /de nas rang gi snying ga nas 'od 'phros pas/
